rules.name: canonical_state_over_chat_memory
rules.statement: MV progress and legal next actions come from Canonical Runtime state, artifacts and transition receipts, not chat memory or prose claims.
rules.failure_if_violated: False progress, skipped prerequisites, unsupported history reconstruction.

evidence.summary: Validated by the 2026-08-27 Runtime Consolidation with transition, rollback, resume, migration and Web Bridge evidence.

rules.name: accepted_k0_over_old_prose
rules.statement: When an actual Reference/K0 has been accepted, downstream prompts follow the real accepted asset state rather than reconstructing an abandoned Director plan.
rules.failure_if_violated: Prompt asks the video model to contradict its actual start image, increasing identity/object/space drift.

evidence.summary: Repeatedly promoted in current Director, First-frame QA and AI video rules.

rules.name: first_frame_character_closure
rules.statement: A generated source should not introduce new human characters that are absent from the accepted K0 when character identity continuity is required.
rules.failure_if_violated: Random character creation, identity drift and unusable continuity.

evidence.summary: Long-running production rule under the earlier Seedance workflow; requires model-specific revalidation for 2.5.

rules.name: legacy_full_prompt_control_skeleton
rules.statement: The legacy 15-block prompt-control skeleton may improve difficult I2V control, but must not be assumed necessary for every Seedance 2.5 source without direct comparison.
rules.failure_if_violated: If wrongly kept: attention dilution and prompt debt. If wrongly removed: possible stability loss on difficult shots.

evidence.summary: Current ai_video rule reports prior cross-song validation, while the new Lean Harness audit identifies possible attention and maintenance cost. Revalidation is required rather than automatic inheritance.

rules.name: positive_first_prompting
rules.statement: Describe the desired result, performance, camera relation, primary visual event and endpoint before using a small number of high-value negative constraints.
rules.failure_if_violated: Potential attention dilution when prompts become histories of prohibited failures.

evidence.summary: Design hypothesis derived from Harness cleanup; not yet production-validated on Seedance 2.5.

rules.name: hard_constraint_budget
rules.statement: Target 0-3 hard constraints; review 4-5 for positive rewrite/parameter/validator migration; block >5 in the experimental compiler until simplified.
rules.failure_if_violated: Constraint accumulation may increase conflict, attention dilution and maintenance cost.

evidence.summary: Experimental governance rule; requires Seedance 2.5 benchmark before production promotion.
